meta.title: MiniMax daily check-in
meta.description: Claims the MiniMax daily check-in reward from inside DeepSeek Harness. It reuses the sign-in MiniMax Code already stored on this machine, so MiniMax Code does not have to be open, and it can run the claim on a daily schedule.

checkin.title: MiniMax daily check-in
checkin.signIn: Open MiniMax Code and sign in again so the daily check-in can run.
